title: Arrays and Lists
introduction: Arrays and generic lists store ordered groups of values of one element type.
learningOutcomes: Create a typed array and List.
Read collection elements safely by position or foreach loop.
Choose between a fixed-size array and a resizable List.

activities.question: Which property reports the number of elements in a List<T>?
activities.explanation: List<T>.Count reports the number of elements currently stored in the list.

activities.question: The first element in a non-empty C# array is at index 0.
activities.explanation: C# arrays and lists use zero-based indexing.
